Cancellation or any exception while parked in acquire is caught by except BaseException (183-186), which calls _release_queue_entry and re-raises. Once acquired, the yield sits in try/finally (188-192), so every exit (normal, exception, cancellation, GeneratorExit) runs release then _release_queue_entry. _release_queue_entry (141-151) deletes the entry when users<=0 and it is still the registered entry. An exception from entry.lock.release() could skip the bookkeeping, but release only raises if the lock is unlocked, and this call holds it, so that is unreachable.
